items.summary: Schwab Advisor Services' digital onboarding now lets firms add PDF forms to digital envelopes and countersign their own documents.
Syntax Direct personalized indexing is now available through iRebal without changing existing workflows.
Clients can eAuthorize wires and checks submitted via Import Transactions, with up to 2,000 transactions per upload.

Jotform's pricing page advertises a limited-time Black Friday discount on annual plans (not Enterprise); no dates or amounts are shown publicly. Listed prices are unchanged: Bronze $39, Silver $49, Gold $129 monthly.
